packageRules.description: One combined PR for every dependency across nuget, npm, and github-actions — Paul merges a single PR.
@types/vscode MUST stay <= engines.vscode (^1.85.0) or `vsce package` refuses to package the extension (broke publish runs #154/#155). Bump it manually only when raising the engines floor.
typescript majors (6.x) drop the node global typings under module:Node16 and break tsc (broke publish runs #154/#155). Allow minor/patch only.

Microsoft.VisualStudio.SDK 18.x depends on packages not published to nuget.org (Microsoft.VisualStudio.Validation >= 18.7.19, Composition >= 18.9.89, ...), so restore fails with NU1102 (broke #105). Stay on 17.x until they are.

Microsoft.VSSDK.BuildTools 18.11+ depends on Microsoft.VisualStudio.SDK.Analyzers versions not published to nuget.org (18.12.1606 needs 17.7.179; the newest on nuget.org is 17.7.122), so restore fails with NU1102 (broke #105). 18.9.820 is the newest whose dependencies all exist.
Hold the .NET 11 runtime packages (10.0.x -> 11.0.0) until Paul decides to move to .NET 11. Patch/minor 10.x updates still flow.
Hold @types/node 26 with the Node 26 hold below. Patch/minor 24.x updates still flow.
Hold the CI .NET SDK on 10.0.x (dotnet-version in the workflows) with the .NET 11 package hold above.
Hold CI Node on 24.x (node-version in the workflows; 26.x was proposed in #105). Patch/minor updates still flow.
